Class GridSelectionModel

java.lang.Object
de.schladebeck.fx.grid.GridSelectionModel
All Implemented Interfaces:
javafx.beans.Observable
public final class GridSelectionModel extends Object implements javafx.beans.Observable

Rectangular ranges of view cells plus an anchor and a focused cell, which is always one cell. Selecting a million rows costs one range. What a click selects depends on the SelectionMode.

Listeners (Observable) hear about every change. The grid keeps the selection on its rows when they are sorted, filtered, inserted or deleted (see Grid); a row inserted inside a selected range is selected too. Whole columns (selectColumn(int, boolean), selectAll()) stay whole when rows are added, whole rows when columns are moved or hidden.
